description: This file defines core classes and state management logic for handling courses within a Flutter application. It includes models like CourseSummary and a provider class CoursesProvider which manages course data, filtering, loading, and enrollment functionalities.

classes.name: CourseSummary
classes.description: A lightweight immutable model representing summary information about a course, used mainly for listings.

classes.name: CoursesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based class managing the state of course data, including loading, filtering, enrollment, and search functionalities.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads course summaries either from mock service or real API based on environment configuration.

methods.name: setSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the current search query used to filter the course list.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the active category filter for the courses.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Searches for a course by ID in the current list and returns it if found.

methods.name: isEnrolled
methods.description: Checks if a course with a given ID is enrolled.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls a user in a course, updating state accordingly, with mock or real API handling.

methods.name: unlockForTesting
methods.description: Marks a course as enrolled for testing purposes, bypassing payment.
